::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Google's gChips team in Bengaluru designs custom silicon for Pixel devices and cloud infrastructure. The team was built by hiring senior engineers from Intel, Qualcomm, Broadcom, and NVIDIA.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Tensor mobile SoCs for Pixel phones, TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) components for cloud AI, and custom server silicon. Bengaluru handles architecture, RTL design, and verification.
